desc:
⚔️ 145+ CARDS — every ability has its OWN battle cinematic! 🌪️ LIVE WEATHERS drop EXCLUSIVE cards!

👋 Welcome to Brainrot Card Battles!

How to Play:
📦 Roll card packs & collect 145+ Brainrot Cards across 9 rarities!
⚔️ Battle bosses through 18 WORLDS & climb the Boss Towers!
🌪️ Survive 9 live weather events — beat storm bosses for EXCLUSIVE cards!
🧬 Reroll TRAITS & hunt CORRUPTED variants with insane boosts!
💰 Trade, auction & flex LIMITED cards — only a small amount will EVER exist!

🛡️ Join a GUILD — raid bosses & win Guild Wars!
🥚 Hatch pets, fuse cards & make Genie wishes!
💤 Going AFK? Auto-rejoin keeps your playtime rewards rolling!

🔥 Top the leaderboards & flex the RAREST roll in the game!
👍 Like & join the group for FREE codes + updates!

Game Day Bonus:
⚡Mon-Tue: 2x GOLD
⚡Wed-Thurs: 1.5x BOSS DROPS 
⚡Friday-Sun: 1.5x LUCK
